title: Easton realization, GCH, and SCH
deferred_material: Easton's realization theorem for continuum functions on regular cardinals; consistency or independence results about GCH and SCH
supporting_development_needed: Use the existing model-witness criteria, membership semantics, generic-extension theorem, elementary ccc preservation and internal GCH theorem for L as foundations. Develop the higher chain-condition, closure and iteration framework needed for Easton realization, supply the required forcing witnesses for GCH or SCH claims, and prove the finite-fragment metatheory for syntactic relative-consistency conclusions. Internal GCH and necessary continuum inequalities alone do not establish those realization or independence theorems.
